summary: Public Storage filed an 8-K on 2026-11-06 reporting entry into a material definitive agreement and the creation of a direct financial obligation, alongside Item 9.01 exhibits. The filing relates to debt/guarantee arrangements, with registered securities including common shares and numerous preferred series, plus guarantees of 0.875% Senior Notes due 2032 issued by Public Storage Operating Company. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, going-private, spin-off, or capital-return event is disclosed. This is a routine financing/capital-structure current report; no special-situation angle or risk-arb setup applies.
